spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: Renounce the promise, first father, and this ends. One word from you, and I loose the hook.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eye-level three-quarter from camera left

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: The promise is not mine to renounce. I did not speak it into being, and I will not unsay it here.
spoken.angle: 100mm facial close-up, slightly low front-right

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: You are dust. Dust has no inheritance. Tell me what ashes may claim from the living God.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, true profile camera left

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: I am dust—and guilty before Him. Yet the dust is His, and still I belong to God.
spoken.angle: 135mm extreme close-up on eyes and mouth, slight high angle

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: Look upon the inheritance of rebellion. Kingdoms fall, names perish, and every proud crown is broken here.
spoken.angle: 50mm two-shot, both figures readable

spoken.speaker: EVE
spoken.dialogue: Adam—look at me. Let not his darkness make strangers of us again.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eight-degree Dutch, three-quarter camera right

spoken.speaker: MOSES
spoken.dialogue: Hold fast, Adam. These chains may bind the hand, but not the promise.
spoken.angle: 65mm medium close-up face and shoulders, eye-level front

spoken.speaker: MOSES
spoken.dialogue: You do not wait alone.
spoken.angle: 40mm medium including chains and iron tree

spoken.speaker: MOSES
spoken.dialogue: He claims no innocence, and asks no wage. He waits upon the mercy of the God who judges him.
spoken.angle: 24mm wider court coverage while the speaker remains dominant

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: Your Messiah is dead. His blood is cold, and the grave has sealed its mouth upon Him.
spoken.angle: 50mm two-shot, both figures readable

spoken.speaker: MOSES
spoken.dialogue: Then why do you tremble? You did not gather the faithful by judgment.
spoken.angle: 100mm facial close-up over the listener's shoulder from camera right

spoken.speaker: MOSES
spoken.dialogue: You seized them because His death frightened you.
spoken.angle: 40mm medium including chains and iron tree

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: Then let Him come. Let Him descend into my kingdom. Adam shall be the pledge of His defeat.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, fifteen-degree high looking down

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: You blamed her once, when fear found you in the garden. Will you condemn her again, here before all the dead?
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eye-level three-quarter from camera left

spoken.speaker: EVE
spoken.dialogue: No. I chose the serpent’s lie, and the wound is mine. I will not escape my guilt by choosing your lie now.
spoken.angle: 100mm facial close-up, slightly low front-right

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: In the garden, when judgment found you, you set her name between yourself and the face of God.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, true profile camera left

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: I named her when I should have confessed. I made of her a shield for my fear.
spoken.angle: 135mm extreme close-up on eyes and mouth, slight high angle

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: Never again.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eight-degree Dutch, three-quarter camera right

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: He found us hiding among the trees, clothed only in shame. Yet He covered us with His own hand.
spoken.angle: 65mm medium close-up face and shoulders, eye-level front

spoken.speaker: ADAM
spoken.dialogue: Then He promised the woman’s Son would crush the serpent. The wound would be His, and the victory would be God’s.
spoken.angle: 100mm facial close-up over the listener's shoulder from camera right

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: Sons beyond counting have crossed these gates: kings, prophets, beggars, all swallowed by the same night.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, fifteen-degree high looking down

spoken.speaker: TORTURER
spoken.dialogue: So where is the Son you were promised? Why does He not answer from beyond the stone?
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eye-level three-quarter from camera left

spoken.speaker: DAVID
spoken.dialogue: You will not abandon my soul to Sheol. Even in the depths, I will wait for You.
spoken.angle: 100mm facial close-up, slightly low front-right

spoken.speaker: DAVID
spoken.dialogue: Nor will You let Your Holy One see corruption. The grave shall not possess Him.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, true profile camera left

spoken.speaker: JOHN
spoken.dialogue: Be still.
spoken.angle: 135mm extreme close-up on eyes and mouth, slight high angle

spoken.speaker: JOHN
spoken.dialogue: I know that tread. I heard it beside the Jordan, when heaven opened and the waters bore witness.
spoken.angle: 85mm facial close-up, eight-degree Dutch, three-quarter camera right

spoken.speaker: JOHN
spoken.dialogue: Death has taken the One whom death cannot hold. The grave has opened its mouth upon its own undoing.
spoken.angle: 24mm wider court coverage while the speaker remains dominant
